description: Delete one of the company brain's raw source files, and the stored document with it. Not reversible. Every page that linked it is repaired in the same move — the link becomes [Source removed], and what the page says is left untouched. A source is the record a page was built from, so a page that turns out to be wrong is a reason to fix the page, not to remove its source. This is for something that should never have been uploaded. The user is asked to confirm before it happens.

source_id.description: The source's id, as listed by list_wiki_sources.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: delete_wiki_source
